title: Teacher misconduct panel outcome:  Mr Thomas Wilson
description: Professional conduct panel outcome, including decision and reasons.

details.body:
The Secretary of State does not make these decisions themselves. They are made by a senior official on the recommendation of an independent panel.

Teacher’s name: Mr Thomas Wilson

Teacher reference number: 0857813

Teacher’s date of birth: 15 June 1988

Location teacher worked: Manchester, North west England

Date of professional conduct panel: 13 to 17 July 2026

Outcome type: Prohibition order

Notice is hereby given that, in accordance with The Teachers’ Disciplinary (England) Regulations 2012, a professional conduct panel was convened to consider the case of Mr Thomas Wilson formerly employed in Manchester, Northwest England.
